# Vendored front-end files

Served from here so the UI works with no network (the offline demo) and no third-party CDN.
All are open source; each folder keeps its license file.

| Folder | Package and version | License |
|---|---|---|
| `maplibre-gl/` | MapLibre GL JS 5.6.0 | BSD-3-Clause (`LICENSE.txt`) |
| `pannellum/` | Pannellum 2.5.6 | MIT (`COPYING`) |
| `cytoscape/` | Cytoscape.js 3.30.4 | MIT |
| `cytoscape-fcose/` | cytoscape-fcose 2.2.0, cose-base 2.2.0, layout-base 2.0.1 | MIT |
| `chartjs/` | Chart.js 4.4.1 | MIT (`LICENSE.md`) |
| `leaflet/` | Leaflet 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause |
| `fonts/` | Geist and Geist Mono (geist 1.3.1) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `naturalearth/` | Natural Earth 1:110m land (v5.1.2) | Public domain |
